_comment: Line-spelling vectors: does a list of saved line breaks spell the caption? The canonical rule, in this order: NFC, strip every \p{Cf} character, collapse whitespace the way Python's str.split() does (JS \s plus U+001C-001F and U+0085; NBSP and U+3000 are whitespace), lowercase (not casefold). Lines are joined with one space before the comparison. The Worker's labCaptionText (src/domain/captions.js) and the Lab's line_breaks check must give the same answer on every vector. The Lab copies this file byte-for-byte. Answers were derived from the rule and cross-checked by an independent implementation.
